text: I can't believe the train is late again. The platform is empty, the rain has stopped, and somewhere a clock is still ticking. We waited all morning for one answer, and now the afternoon is nearly gone.

narrator._why: OFF by default. A narrator preset is more natural and more intelligible but is a different person. Turn on only if you want that instead of a clone of your own reference.

_text_source: Replace the text above with a word-for-word transcript of your own recording. A wrong transcript teaches wrong pronunciations because the cloned voice is conditioned on it.
